description_zh: 查零跑车型与配置，比较年款版本差异与差价构成，按预算和补能条件整理选车候选，估算含购置税的落地成本并附来源。覆盖 C10、C11、C16 的 2027 款共 17 个版本。基于公开信息，非官方服务。
description_en: Look up Leapmotor models and trims, compare versions, shortlist by budget and charging needs, estimate on-road cost including purchase tax, and prepare test-drive and order checklists with cited sources. Covers 17 China-market 2027 trims across C10, C11 and C16. Unofficial public information assistant.
author: EnderZhou
